module: Read the Act and frame an AI use case

lesson.title: Dates and transition
lesson.summary: Separate entry into force, provision-specific application and conditional transition rules.

prerequisites.reason: The learner must locate the specified provision before choosing its application date.

blocks: **Entry into force** is when a legal instrument becomes operative as law. **Application** is when particular provisions begin applying. These can be different dates. Publication is another distinct event.

The original AI Act was published on 12 July 2024 and entered into force twenty days later, on 1 August 2024. The 2026 amendment entered into force on 27 July 2026. Use the authentic instruments for these events.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Articles 111, 113; Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 Article 2

blocks: Article 113 supplies several application dates. Chapters I and II generally began on 2 February 2025. The newly inserted Article 5(1)(ba), (bb), (1a) and (1b) instead apply from **2 December 2026**. The default date is **2 August 2026**, with specified exceptions.
Chapter V's model rules and other listed chapters began on 2 August 2025, with Article 101 excepted. Articles 102–110 apply from 27 July 2026. Identify the provision before selecting a date.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Articles 111, 113; Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 Article 2

blocks: The amended high-risk timing separates the two routes. Chapter III Sections 1–3, except Article 6(5), apply to Annex III systems from **2 December 2027**, and Annex I systems from **2 August 2028**.

Those dates do not postpone every other rule for a system. An applicable prohibition or transparency duty needs its own date. Article 6(5), concerning guidance, is explicitly excepted from this postponement.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Articles 111, 113; Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 Article 2

blocks: A **transition check** examines Article 111 and the system's or model's market/service history. Relevant existing high-risk systems have conditional treatment tied to significant design changes, with a public-authority compliance date. It is not a universal grandfathering permission.

GPAI models placed before 2 August 2025 have a 2 August 2027 compliance date. Article 111(4) gives specified synthetic-content system providers with pre-2-August-2026 placement until 2 December 2026 for Article 50(2). Apply exact conditions; do not extend that date to all Article 50 duties.
